name: Unidad de Medida y Actualización
note: The daily value of Mexico's Unidad de Medida y Actualización in pesos, by the day each value took effect, from INEGI, which calculates it and publishes it in the Diario Oficial de la Federación (DOF). INEGI's UMA page (read rendered on 2026-10-30) gives the daily, monthly and annual value for each year from 2016 to 2026; the monthly is the daily times 30.4 and the annual the monthly times 12, so only the daily value is held here. When each value applies: the first value (73.04, equal to the general minimum wage) was set by the desindexation decree (DOF 27 January 2016), which came into force the day after its publication, so 28 January 2016; INEGI published it in the DOF on 28 January 2016 'en el año 2016', and its 2017 bulletin says the initial values were published on 28 January 2016 based on the minimum wage in force on that date. From 2017 every value took effect on 1 February of its year: INEGI says so for 2017 (bulletin 8/17 and its DOF notice of 10 January 2018), 2018 (DOF 10 January 2018), 2019 and 2020 (press releases), 2021 (DOF 8 January 2021) and 2022 to 2026 (press releases), under article 5 of the Ley para Determinar el Valor de la UMA. INEGI's 2018 and 2021 press releases do not name the day, so their DOF notices are cited for it. Each value holds until the next one takes effect; the 2026 value (117.31) is in force from 1 February 2026 until INEGI's 2027 value, which by the same rule takes effect on 1 February 2027 and is not yet published on 2026-10-30. The form doesn't hold the monthly or annual values, nor the December INPC variation each update rests on.

sources.title: INEGI, Unidad de Medida y Actualización (UMA), Valor de la UMA (page rendered 2026-10-30)
DOF 27/01/2016, Decreto por el que se declara reformadas y adicionadas diversas disposiciones de la Constitución, en materia de desindexación del salario mínimo
sources.said: Primero.- El presente Decreto entrará en vigor el día siguiente al de su publicación en el Diario Oficial de la Federación. ... Segundo.- El valor inicial diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización, a la fecha de entrada en vigor del presente Decreto será equivalente al que tenga el salario mínimo general vigente diario para todo el país

sources.title: DOF 28/01/2016, INEGI, Unidad de Medida y Actualización
sources.said: DOF: 28/01/2016 ... el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía determina que el valor diario de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización es de $73.04 pesos mexicanos, el mensual es de $2,220.42 pesos mexicanos y el valor anual $ 26,645.04 pesos mexicanos, en el año 2016.
